functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_manage_school(requested_school uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.is_platform_admin() or private.has_school_role(requested_school, array['school_admin']); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles(id, display_name)
  values (new.id, left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name'), ''), nullif(split_part(new.email, '@', 1), ''), 'New user'), 150));
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_school_role(requested_school uuid, allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.school_memberships m
    join public.schools s on s.id = m.school_id
    where m.school_id = requested_school
      and m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and m.status = 'active' and s.status = 'active'
      and m.role = any(allowed_roles)
  );
$function$

functions.arguments: requested_school uuid, requested_class uuid, requested_subject uuid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_teaching_assignment(requested_school uuid, requested_class uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, requested_subject uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.teacher_assignments a
    where a.school_id = requested_school and a.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and (requested_class is null or a.class_id = requested_class)
      and (requested_subject is null or a.subject_id = requested_subject)
      and private.has_school_role(a.school_id, array[a.role])
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from private.platform_admins
    where user_id = (select auth.uid()) and active
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.is_platform_admin(); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_school_teacher_accounts(requested_school uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, display_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
  if not private.can_manage_school(requested_school) then raise exception 'School administrator access required.'; end if;
  return query select distinct u.id, u.email::text, p.display_name
    from public.school_memberships m
    join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id
    left join public.profiles p on p.id = u.id
    where m.school_id = requested_school and m.role in ('subject_teacher', 'class_teacher');
end; $function$
